{{Top|leg}}
'''Chip encoders''' were systems used to write data onto, and retrieve data from, a [[micro-chip]]. [[Servenidain Securities, Limited]] [[Data Bio-Encryptor]] used chip encoders to write data onto micro-chips that were then encased in a jell-like substance for ingestion.
